+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.rule import Rule
+from io import StringIO
+import sys
+
+def test_rule_width():
+    # Use a fixed width console
+    console = Console(width=20, force_terminal=False)
+    
+    # title_text = "Hello" (5 chars)
+    # width = 20
+    # side_width = (20 - 5) // 2 = 7
+    # left = "─" * (7 // 1 + 1) = "────────" (8 chars)
+    # left.truncate(7 - 1) = "──────" (6 chars)
+    # right_length = 20 - 6 - 5 = 9
+    # right = "─" * (7 // 1 + 1) = "────────" (8 chars)
+    # right.truncate(9) = "────────" (8 chars)
+    # rule_text = left.plain + " " + title_text + " " + right.plain
+    # rule_text = "──────" + " " + "Hello" + " " + "────────"
+    # len(rule_text) = 6 + 1 + 5 + 1 + 8 = 21
+    
+    rule = Rule(title="Hello", align="center")
+    
+    output = StringIO()
+    console.file = output
+    console.print(rule)
+    
+    result = output.getvalue().strip()
+    print(f"Result: '{result}'")
+    print(f"Length: {len(result)}")
+    
+    assert len(result) == 20, f"Expected length 20, got {len(result)}"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_rule_width()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        sys.exit(1)
